training_objective: first outfield teammate pass bonus0.1 once/episode; positive goal/checkpoint reward unlocks after pass; explicit policy phase in padding slot21, consistent training/bootstrap/eval; raw engine snapshots unchanged; schema3 tracking
revision: e; training-only finishing curriculum; trials a/b/c/d opened zero confirmation logs
curriculum: independent episode-seed hash approximately50:50 full cooperation phase0 / finishing practice phase1; practice raw score/checkpoints, no artificial pass credit; all evaluation phase0
roster: one fixed learning attacker, one engine-AI teammate, one engine-AI defender, two goalkeepers; all AI logic fixed
selection: sampled-policy validation scoring success; insertion-order ties; frozen before held-out evaluation
geometry: 12 starts/partition; attacker x=.44+.06*i,y=-.16+.16*j; ball x=attacker x+.02; each partition adds .0125*partition to attacker x/y; AI teammate x+.12 opposite wing, defender x+.15/y*.25
argmax_reporting: Retained as secondary raw/batch results; no greedy-performance claim
cooperation_gate: each final seed: at least10% confirmation episodes with completed_passes>0; decision-boundary approximation, requests are not kicks
pilot_gate: validation success>=.3 and fraction episodes with completed_passes>0 >=.1; otherwise preserve pilots and stop before confirmation
success: controlled_score_delta>0 before horizon; failures/truncations remain failures
gates: task mean and per-training-seed minima in tasks; each seed beats initial and random; crossed paired bootstrap lower95>0 against both
scope: Bounded fixed-attacker 2v1 with AI teammate/defender/GKs; not joint control or11v11; no confirmation-based retuning
